hardware: x86_64 Linux container, 4 vCPU, full Docker Compose stack; scorer run on the host against it (not the target Mac)
setup: 100,000 seeded vehicles; simulator at 10,000 ev/s (each vehicle reports every 10 s) for ~6 minutes; model failure-7d-v3
finding: Without a coverage gate, 8.1-8.3% of vehicles scored above 0.5 after ~6 minutes of data. The top explanation for such vehicles was a trend slope (e.g. cell_delta_slope_h +3.3 log-odds): slopes fitted to a few noisy minute buckets. The model was trained on full 60-minute windows.

offline_full_window_low_rate_run.source: ml/data/m8/test_lowrate (vehicles report every 10 s, full windows)

not_yet_measured: Live score distribution over full 60-minute windows, and the effect of real-time (uncompressed) degradation. This is what shadow mode (ADR-008) is for.
